title: Field Transfer Studio
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting field transfer studio to field-placement transfer note connecting tool choice to classroom constraints, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Thread a single technology decision through the chapter's tools (transfer, observation, audit, revision, voice) into one coherent argument
Make a context-bound decision legible to an outsider who was never in the placement
Document a bounded AI/software support move, including an AI narrative you corrected for erasing a real tension
Demonstrate transfer by showing the same decision rule holding across two situations under different constraints

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
